planets.name: HD 207496 b
planets.description: HD 207496 b crosses its star every 6.44 days and is 2.3 times as wide as Earth, found in 2023.

text.card: HD 207496 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HD 207496. Its orbit and size follow Barros et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
